# dmapi_assistant_tool

> Ask questions about the Data Model API (DMAPI) platform implementation, architecture, and features.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `documentation` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=dmapi_assistant_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Ask questions about the Data Model API (DMAPI) platform implementation, architecture, and features.
This tool uses the project documentation to provide accurate answers about:

- Security system and capability-based access control
- LLM integration and autonomous agents
- API endpoints and response formats
- Model relationships and database structure
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration
- Guest engagement system
- Webhook system
- And much more!

The tool searches through the comprehensive DMAPI documentation to provide detailed, 
accurate answers based on the actual implementation.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | string | yes | The question about DMAPI implementation, features, or architecture. |
| `category` | string | no | Optional category to focus the search. One of: `security`, `llm`, `api`, `models`, `mcp`, `webhooks`, `guest`, `general`. |
| `detail_level` | string | no | Level of detail in the response. One of: `brief`, `normal`, `detailed`. Default: `normal`. |
